response.sql: WITH station_stats AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS num_telescopes FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(num_telescopes * 1.0) AS avg_telescopes FROM station_stats) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandusagepct, s.num_telescopes, s.num_telescopes / a.avg_telescopes AS telescope_ratio FROM station_stats s CROSS JOIN avg_count a ORDER BY telescope_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The 'average telescope count across those stations' is the mean of the per-station telescope counts, taken only over stations with at least one telescope. This equals total telescopes divided by the number of such stations.
Telescopes with a NULL bandusagepct still count toward num_telescopes. NULLs are excluded only from the average bandwidth usage, as the request states.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only telescopes that have a bandwidth usage value, so num_telescopes and the average telescope count both ignore telescopes with missing bandusagepct. Stations whose telescopes all lack bandwidth data drop out.
alternatives.sql: WITH station_stats AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS num_telescopes FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(num_telescopes * 1.0) AS avg_telescopes FROM station_stats) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandusagepct, s.num_telescopes, s.num_telescopes / a.avg_telescopes AS telescope_ratio FROM station_stats s CROSS JOIN avg_count a ORDER BY telescope_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
